Row

A flex-based row component for horizontal layout with column support, alignment, and ordering utilities.

Basic Row

Use .zak-row with .zak-col children to create a horizontal layout. Columns will share equal width by default.

Column 1
Column 2
Column 3
HTML
<div class="zak-row">
  <div class="zak-col">Column 1</div>
  <div class="zak-col">Column 2</div>
  <div class="zak-col">Column 3</div>
</div>

Column Sizing

Use .zak-col-{n} to set a column's width as a fraction of 12. For example, .zak-col-4 takes up 4/12 (33.3%) of the row.

1
11
4
4
4
3
6
3
6
6
HTML
<div class="zak-row">
  <div class="zak-col-1">1</div>
  <div class="zak-col-11">11</div>
</div>

<div class="zak-row">
  <div class="zak-col-4">4</div>
  <div class="zak-col-4">4</div>
  <div class="zak-col-4">4</div>
</div>

<div class="zak-row">
  <div class="zak-col-3">3</div>
  <div class="zak-col-6">6</div>
  <div class="zak-col-3">3</div>
</div>

Responsive Columns

Use breakpoint prefixes to change column widths at specific screen sizes. Columns stack vertically on smaller screens by default.

12 / 6 / 4 / 3
12 / 6 / 4 / 3
12 / 6 / 4 / 3
12 / 6 / 12 / 3
HTML
<div class="zak-row">
  <div class="zak-col-12 zak-col-sm-6 zak-col-md-4 zak-col-lg-3">
    Responsive column
  </div>
</div>

Column Ordering

Use .zak-order-{n} to control the visual order of columns independent of DOM order.

First (order: 3)
Second (order: 1)
Third (order: 2)
HTML
<div class="zak-row">
  <div class="zak-col-4 zak-order-3">First (order: 3)</div>
  <div class="zak-col-4 zak-order-1">Second (order: 1)</div>
  <div class="zak-col-4 zak-order-2">Third (order: 2)</div>
</div>

CSS Reference

HTML
.zak-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-left: -0.5rem;
  margin-right: -0.5rem;
}

.zak-col {
  flex: 1 0 0%;
  padding-left: 0.5rem;
  padding-right: 0.5rem;
}

.zak-col-1 { flex: 0 0 8.333%; max-width: 8.333%; }
.zak-col-2 { flex: 0 0 16.667%; max-width: 16.667%; }
.zak-col-3 { flex: 0 0 25%; max-width: 25%; }
.zak-col-4 { flex: 0 0 33.333%; max-width: 33.333%; }
.zak-col-6 { flex: 0 0 50%; max-width: 50%; }
.zak-col-12 { flex: 0 0 100%; max-width: 100%; }

Accessibility

  • The row uses display: flex which maintains a logical reading order in the DOM
  • Use order sparingly — it can confuse screen reader users if visual order differs from DOM order
  • Ensure columns contain meaningful content that reads logically without CSS
